sentences.en: He spoke to his men.
sentences.zh: 他说到他的男人们。

sentences.en: Soon they pulled the wagons out of the mud.
sentences.zh: 很快他们拉这马车出的这淤泥。

sentences.en: At last, the wagon train was able to go on.
sentences.zh: 在最后的， 这马车火车是有到去在……上。

sentences.en: The children watched them for a long time.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们手表他们为了一个长的时间。

sentences.en: "I wouldn't like to be on that wagon train," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不会喜欢到是在……上那个马车火车， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "It would be a hard journey.
sentences.zh: 它将是一个困难的旅行。

sentences.en: There are no shops to buy food.
sentences.zh: 那里是不商店到买食物。

sentences.en: And there isn't a doctor if they are ill."
sentences.zh: 和那里不是一个医生如果他们是有病的。

sentences.en: The magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: It was time for the adventure to end.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了这冒险到末尾。

sentences.en: Biff gave Little Fox the umbrella.
sentences.zh: Biff 给小的狐狸这雨伞。

sentences.en: "You can use it to frighten away the bears," she laughed.
sentences.zh: 你能使用它到使离开这承载， 她笑。

sentences.en: Biff looked at Wilf and Chip.
sentences.zh: Biff 看在 Wilf 和 Chip。

sentences.en: "Umbrellas are useful in a survival kit after all," she said.
sentences.zh: 雨伞是有用的在……里一个存留成套工具在……之后全部， 她说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: 我看见， 他说。

sentences.en: The children liked the survival adventure.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们喜欢这存留冒险。

sentences.en: The next day, they put the tent up.
sentences.zh: 这下一个一天， 他们放这帐篷向上。

sentences.en: Biff wanted to make Wilf and Chip laugh.
sentences.zh: Biff 想要到做 Wilf 和 Chip 笑。

sentences.en: "Look what's outside!" She said.
sentences.zh: 看是什么外面！ 她说。

sentences.en: "And I haven't got my umbrella, now." "Oh, no," Laughed Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我没有得到我的雨伞， 现在。 哦不！ 哦不， 笑 Wilf。

sentences.en: "What shall we do?
sentences.zh: 什么将我们做？

sentences.en: We can't survive without Biff's umbrella."
sentences.zh: 我们不能存留没有 Biff 雨伞。
